alt.en: Copenhagen harbour at night: a low moon behind banks of cloud lays a bright path across still water, ships' masts and spires stand in silhouette along the far quay, and dark boats with a few figures sit in the foreground.
alt.zh: 夜里的哥本哈根港：低垂的月亮藏在层层云后，在平静的水面上铺出一道亮光；远处码头上船桅和尖塔映成剪影，前景里是几条暗色的船和几个人影。

note.en: Dahl was a Norwegian painter who lived in Dresden, a close friend of Friedrich and a careful student of real skies. Copenhagen is the city where he trained as a young man. The moonlight here is not dramatic; it is the exact, ordinary light of a working harbour at the end of the day.
note.zh: 达尔是定居德累斯顿的挪威画家，弗里德里希的挚友，也是一位认真观察真实天空的人。哥本哈根是他年轻时学画的城市。这里的月光并不戏剧化，而是一座劳作的港口在一天结束时那种准确而寻常的光。
